title: Factors in Deciding Number of People for Various Gatherings in Phase Three of Safe Reopening
what_it_is: Factors in Deciding Number of People for Various Gatherings in Phase Three of Safe Reopening

sections.label: Phase Three opening questions
sections.summary: An MP asked the Minister for Health about factors for gathering limits, compliance safeguards, and plans for a COVID-19 spike in Phase Three.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health regarding the possible Phase Three opening by end-December 2020 (a) what factors are taken into account when deciding on the maximum number of people allowed for gatherings, weddings and other events; (b) what will be the safeguards and measures in place to ensure compliance when more activities resume on a larger scale; and (c) what plans are in place should there be a spike of COVID-19 cases in Phase Three and whether that includes reversion to Phase Two.

sections.label: Cautious group size increase
sections.summary: A cautious approach is taken, considering raising the group size limit from five to eight persons in Phase Three for dining and social gathering.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Hence, we have taken a cautious approach in expanding group sizes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We are considering an increase in the group size limit from the current five persons to eight persons in Phase Three for dining and social gathering.

sections.label: Wedding clusters and participant cap
sections.summary: Wedding clusters occurred in India, Jordan, New Zealand, the United States and other countries, but pleas exist to raise the 100-participant cap.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We have seen clusters arising from weddings in places as diverse as India, Jordan, New Zealand, the United States and many other countries.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: However, there have been pleas to raise the cap on number of wedding participants beyond the current limit of 100 in zones or timeslots of no more than 50 each.

sections.label: Pre-event testing for weddings
sections.summary: COVID-19 testing, including pilot pre-event testing, could let higher risk activities like weddings scale up safely by reducing the probability of a case at the event.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Going forward, one key enabler that could allow more activities to resume, and potentially at higher capacity limits, is COVID-19 testing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We are piloting the use of pre-event testing to allow higher risk activities including weddings to scale up safely, by reducing the probability of a COVID-19 case being present at the event, thereby reducing the risk of transmission.

sections.label: Phase Three steady state objective
sections.summary: The objective in Phase Three is a steady state of permitted economic and social activities until an effective vaccine or treatment is widely available.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Our objective in Phase Three is to reach a steady state of permitted economic and social activities until an effective vaccine or treatment is widely available.

sections.label: Managing possible case spikes
sections.summary: Healthcare capacity, contact tracing, testing and safe management measures have been ramped up, but complacency must be avoided when managing possible case spikes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: While we are in a much better position today than we were earlier in the year to manage possible spikes in the number of cases, we must not be complacent.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We have ramped up our healthcare capacity, contact tracing and testing capabilities, and put in place extensive safe management measures in the community, workplaces and dormitories.

sections.label: Phase Three safe measures
sections.summary: To continue to Phase Three, everyone must adhere to safe management measures, maintain good personal hygiene and participate in TraceTogether.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: To continue on our steady path to Phase Three, each of us must play our part to adhere to safe management measures, maintain good personal hygiene and actively participate in the TraceTogether programme.

sections.label: Wedding capacity and testing rules
sections.summary: Weddings can have up to a hundred people, groups of no more than 50, tables of no more than five, and testing is not required.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: And we are doing pilots so that we can iron out some of these issues and concerns that the wedding couples may have.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: But as it is today, you do not have to go for testing, you can have a wedding up to a hundred, with groups of no more than 50 each.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: You can have three tables, four tables, but no more than 50 per group, and each table must have no more than five persons.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Under the current rule, you are not required to be tested but we are looking at whether we can allow larger capacity.
